subject_definitions:<Subject 1> is the young woman Su Xingluo in <Picture 1> , with an oval face, soft natural brows, wide-set round almond eyes, a slim straight nose and full lips, her dark brown-black hair in a high ponytail with loose side strands, wearing a cream-white short-sleeved shirt dress with puff sleeves, a cinched waist and a flared mini skirt, and pointed cream-white stiletto heels.<Subject 2> is the night lawn live-stream corner in <Picture 2> , with the cream-stone villa facade and its glowing ground-floor doors behind an empty light-wood easel position, festoon lights across the upper third of the frame, and a champagne tower on a white-clothed round table at the lower left.<Subject 3> is the torn painting in <Picture 3> , a near-square pale-gold framed oil painting of a seaside garden with a woman in a white dress, torn into two halves along its centre with raw canvas fibres at the break.<Subject 4> is the live-stream rig in <Picture 4> , a black tripod with a horizontal phone clamp and a ring light switched on.
summary:[reference generation] The target video is a ten-second three-shot opening. It begins on a pair of stiletto heels pressing into lawn grass, pulls out to reveal <Subject 1> standing at <Subject 4> inside <Subject 2> while holding the two halves of <Subject 3>, and closes on the torn canvas break. <Subject 1> delivers one line to the phone camera in the middle shot.
retention_analysis:<Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - her face, high ponytail, cream-white dress and heels are retained throughout.<Subject 2> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - the villa facade, festoon lights, champagne tower and lawn backdrop are retained as the same space.<Subject 3> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2], [Shot 3]): fully_preserved - its picture content, pale-gold frame and centre tear are retained.<Subject 4> (appears in [Shot 1], [Shot 2]): fully_preserved - the tripod, horizontal clamp and lit ring light are retained.
detailed_description:The target video is photorealistic live-action Chinese urban short drama footage, with a bright and fully exposed night palette, warm practical lamps behind the subject and one cool white ring light on her face; skin shows real texture rather than a 3D-render surface.[Shot 1] An extreme close-up frames two pointed cream-white stiletto heels pressing into short lawn grass, blades bending and springing back around the heel tips, warm amber light falling from frame left and a cool white spill grazing the instep. At 00:00.600 a sharp fabric-rip sound cuts in off-screen. The camera pulls out with large amplitude at slow speed, the heels sliding toward the lower edge as the frame widens to reveal <Subject 1> standing behind <Subject 4>, whose ring light is switched on and throws a cold white front wash across her face while she grips one half of <Subject 3> in her right hand and the other in her left, the two halves sagging apart above an empty light-wood easel. <Subject 2> fills the background: warm glowing villa doors, festoon lights crossing overhead, the champagne tower at the lower left, guests standing far behind in soft focus.[Shot 2] At 00:03.500 the shot cuts to a medium shot from slightly below the eye line. <Subject 1> leans in toward the clamped phone with her chin lifted and a wide open grin, eyes fixed on the lens, and says in a bright, sweet, slightly teasing voice (S1): <d>[Chinese] 家人们，今天给大家表演一个手撕八位数的名画。</d> Her shoulders stay loose and the two canvas halves tilt with her hands as she speaks.[Shot 3] At 00:08.500 the shot cuts to a close-up of the torn break between her hands, the irregular canvas edges trembling and fibres catching the warm light, one thumb pressing a crease flat; her short breath of laughter is audible as the frame holds.
overall_soundscape:A dense banquet murmur sits under the whole shot, with wine glasses clinking and a distant piano phrase. A crisp fabric rip sounds once near the start, followed by grass brushing against heels and the faint high hum of the ring light.
non_diegetic_music:A light pizzicato string figure at a brisk tempo with small marimba accents, dropping out for one beat under the fabric rip and returning as she leans toward the phone.
